entities.name: Carla Suárez Navarro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carla Suárez Navarro is a Spanish former professional tennis player. A former top 10 singles player, she reached a career-high singles ranking of world No. 6 on 29 February 2016, and a best WTA doubles ranking of 11, on 27 April 2015, and won two singles and three doubles titles on the WTA Tour.

entities.summary: Carla Suárez Navarro is a Spanish former professional tennis player.
